english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a modem, especially one used for an internet or telephone connection.

examples.english: The modem is broken, so I can't get online.
examples.traditional: 個數據機壞咗，我上唔到網。
examples.jyutping: go3 sou3 geoi3 gei1 waai6 zo2 ngo5 soeng5 m4 dou2 mong5
